ticket.title: A Verified task cannot be reopened
ticket.description: storypole update has no status flag and no verb moves a task out of Verified: claim only works on claimable states, unarchive only restores archived, defer only defers. GB-57 is the case in hand, Verified with 0 of 6 plan steps and a manual unscoped receipt, and the only way to correct the record was to file a superseding epic (GB-328). Reopening should be explicit, should record who reopened the task and why, and should keep the old receipt rather than delete it, because a false receipt is itself evidence.
